title: Facesum - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Facesum in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Facesum is a physical-element weapon used by Maelle. It scales with Luck (D), Vitality (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Facesum
sections.content:
Location: Isle of the Eyes.

Obtained from Isle of the Eyes.

sections.title: Is the Facesum Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Luck (D), Vitality (C). A physical-scaling weapon, so it fits any build that is not committed to a specific element.
